title: Release 147: prove numbering, retry keys and retained holds
public_pr_body:
Seven committed-code tests passed, zero skipped, against the unchanged full public schema/release chain at 9d7725e in a newly created nonce-verified network-isolated PostgreSQL container. Synthetic records only; no DB URL or private files.

Covers all 16 current verification rows; blank/typed pre-counter refusal without burning numbers; actual day-of setter and next_doc_number continuation; request_id replay, changed retry refusal and concurrent double submit; wrong-company refusal; and a synthetic stock wipe/negative KEEP violation showing both hold rows/timestamps and other-company stock preserved.

The synthetic stock deletion is NOT the actual JNR wipe. Actual private-kit execution/preservation remains unverified here, owned by Code. No complete wipe proof or real installed/browser state is claimed.

The README explains in one paragraph that the original public verifier at 9e1a82c had 11 assertions. 31f965e added five checks: request hash, ambiguous customers, numbering guard, hold-table protection and hold-before-numbering. Current 9d7725e requires 16 true rows; accepting only 11 would omit checks. Original source counted statically; current verifier executed.

Code 8c67abd; retained original logs and SQL/hash/commit/environment/time/exit/identity archive. Lint and TypeScript passed. Separate branch from main, tests/docs only. No merge, production SQL, private files, #359/go-live edits or message to John.
